reviews.author: krppp@09
reviews.content:
An ambitious and visually breathtaking retelling of one of the greatest epics ever told. What makes Ramayana truly special is not just its scale, grand visuals, or technical brilliance, but the timeless story, profound emotions, and cultural significance behind it.

The film carries the weight of an epic while reminding us of values that transcend generations righteousness, sacrifice, courage, devotion, and the eternal struggle between good and evil. Its larger-than-life presentation makes the experience even more immersive.

Ramayana is not merely a story that deserves to be told; it is a legacy that deserves to be experienced. A promising beginning to an epic journey, leaving us eager for what comes next.

Some stories entertain us. Some stay with us. Ramayana belongs to the latter.
